# Frosted glass

Looks through a pane of frosted glass: a backdrop blur with ripples, a tint and fine grain, matching HoloCSS’s Glass theme. Give it a mask to frost only a panel.

<EffectDemo effect="frosted-glass" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { frostedGlass } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/frosted-glass';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(frostedGlass({ preset: 'bathroom' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.blur = 4`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                                       | Default     | Range     | Description                                                             |
| ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `blur`       | integer                                                    | `4`         | 1 – 8     | Blur passes; each roughly doubles the blur radius.                      |
| `distortion` | number                                                     | `6`         | 0 – 30 px | How far the frost ripples bend the view.                                |
| `frostScale` | number                                                     | `6`         | 1 – 40 px | Size of the ripples.                                                    |
| `tint`       | hex color (theme: [`surface`](/guide/holocss#theme-roles)) | `'#dfe8f5'` |           | Color of the glass.                                                     |
| `tintAmount` | number                                                     | `0.25`      | 0 – 1     | How strongly the glass color shows.                                     |
| `grain`      | number                                                     | `0.03`      | 0 – 0.2   | Fine frost texture.                                                     |
| `seed`       | integer                                                    | `0`         | 0 – 9999  | Picks the random pattern: the same seed always renders the same frames. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                                      |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bathroom`   | `blur: 6`, `distortion: 14`, `frostScale: 4`                  |
| `glassPanel` | `blur: 5`, `distortion: 2`, `tintAmount: 0.35`, `grain: 0.01` |
| `icy`        | `tint: '#cfe9ff'`, `tintAmount: 0.45`, `grain: 0.06`          |
| `clear`      | `blur: 2`, `distortion: 3`, `tintAmount: 0.1`                 |

Apply one with `frostedGlass({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Blur & glow · tracked as story X5.8 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.6 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/frosted-glass`, including the shared effect runtime.
